observations.kicker_before_submenu_create: ItemListView sets kicker.hideOnWindowDeactivate=false before creating the child dialog.
observations.kicker_child_dialog: ItemListDialog binds hideOnWindowDeactivate to kicker.hideOnWindowDeactivate; onWindowDeactivated sets kicker.expanded=false.
observations.kicker_root_representation: MenuRepresentation.reset sets hideOnWindowDeactivate=true and clears the root list selection; windowSystem.hidden is connected to reset.
observations.domainos_focus_in_handler: DomainOSKdeApplicationMenu unconditionally sets kicker.hideOnWindowDeactivate=true on every windowSystem.focusIn.
observations.root_dialog_binding: The DomainOS root PlasmaCore.Dialog follows kicker.hideOnWindowDeactivate, matching the child dialog contract.

interpretation.hypothesis: If the submenu focus-in arrives before the parent deactivation is processed, the unconditional DomainOS focus-in handler may restore hide-on-deactivate too early. The child dialog's own deactivation handler can also close the shared menu. Neither path has been shown to cause the user's hover symptom.
interpretation.required_evidence: Record the order of pointer-enter, child creation, focus-in, root/child deactivation, hidden, shared hideOnWindowDeactivate changes, and expanded changes under a real pointer event in an isolated Wayland session.

next: Use an isolated Wayland test with genuine compositor-delivered pointer events, or inspect the user's post-R619 result if already available.
Only change the focus-in gate after the event order identifies it as causal; then verify immediate search input, hover persistence, repeated open/close, and app launch without restarting KWin.
